caption: The drawing features a single metallic oil can positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The oil can is conical in shape, with a wide circular base that narrows to a smaller, open top. Extending diagonally upward from the left side of the can is a long, cylindrical spout, slightly rusted and colored in shades of gray and brown. Attached to the right side is a simple, curved handle, also gray in color. The main body of the can is shaded with various tones of gray, indicating a well-used or aged appearance with some subtle, rusty brown or orange stains, especially near the base and spout’s joint. The composition is minimalistic, with no other objects or decorative elements present, and the can is rendered with realistic, detailed shading and coloring.
title: Tin Lamp
